title: Error paths
hints: Test the edges of the valid range (`1`, `65535`) and just outside them (`0`, `65536`). Then one input for every error rule, including the sneaky ones: `"+80"`, `"-1"`, `" 80"`.

Put `wantErr error` in the table (nil for valid ports). `errors.Is(err, nil)` is true only when `err` is nil, so one check covers both the success and the error cases. Check the port **as well**, even on error: it must be `0`.
